spec.description:
Bradford Fire Protection - Metal Roof (Bradford Fireseal Party
Wall Sealer for Metal Roofs / Fireseal FZ Metal Roof Batts) is a
high-temperature, non-combustible rockwool insulation product designed to seal
the junction between the top of a fire-rated party wall and metal roof sheeting.
Manufactured from molten rock and blast furnace slag bonded with thermosetting
resin, the 75mm thick blanket or batts are installed under 10-15% compression
beneath corrugated or trapezoidal metal roof profiles. It blocks the passage of
fire, smoke, and burning embers between adjoining tenancies in Class 1 buildings
and meets BAL-FZ bushfire conditions.
features:
Non-combustible stone
wool construction tested to AS 1530.1

75mm thickness tailored specifically
for deeper corrugations of metal roofing profiles

Seals top-of-wall gaps to
prevent flame, spark, and ember spread between tenancies

Highly resistant to
shrinkage and degradation under extreme fire temperatures up to 1000°C
Suitable for Bushfire Attack Level BAL-FZ applications under metal roofs
Bio-soluble FBS-1 formulation safe to handle and install

Performance
unaffected by contact with water

Complies with NCC Volume Two
Deemed-to-Satisfy party wall requirements

install:
Lay Fireseal 75mm Party Wall Sealer along the full length of the
top of the fire-rated wall

Ensure blanket overhangs the wall thickness
symmetrically (300mm or 360mm width)

Fix metal roofing sheets down over the
blanket ensuring at least 10-15% compression across all roof ribs and pans

Where joints in blanket occur, butt tightly together with a minimum 50mm
overlap or Vee cut

Inspect from ceiling space to confirm all corrugations and
crests are fully packed and sealed
selection_checklist:
Confirm roof
cladding type is metal deck / corrugated sheeting (requiring 75mm thickness)

Select width based on wall thickness (300mm for single/standard walls, 360mm
for wider cavity party walls)

Calculate total linear metres needed along the
top of the party wall
Check if project is in a BAL-FZ bushfire attack zone
accessories: Bradford Fireseal Party Wall Batten Fillers
limitations:
Must be compressed
minimum 10-15% by roof sheets to ensure smoke/flame barrier

Not suitable as
exposed roof sarking membrane

Must be protected from pooling water or
continuous weathering

retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford Fire
Protection - Metal Roof (Fireseal Party Wall Sealer for Metal Roofs) is a 75mm
thick, non-combustible rockwool blanket engineered to seal the void between the
head of fire-rated party walls and profiled metal roof sheeting in Class 1
dwellings. Its 75mm thickness compresses by 10-15% under corrugations and
trapezoidal profiles to block flames, sparks, and hot gases from bypassing
separating walls. Certified non-combustible to AS 1530.1 and compliant for
BAL-FZ bushfire construction, it satisfies NCC Deemed-to-Satisfy requirements
for inter-tenancy fire containment.
